differences: Thirteen complete outcomes agree. In chain (Light base Chances, Dark boost, Light boost of that boost) GEMP records 27 damage from base 3: it honors a triple-result flag only in the base function, not in the booster function. A literal recursive reading would produce factor 27 (damage81), but no authoritative clarification for that interaction was located. Native preserves the unresolved stack and rejects applying the ambiguous boosted-booster atomically. The recorded GEMP value is kept and the explicit guard tested; neither full parity nor a new rule is claimed. This edge remains required work before admitting decks that can reach it.
limits: Current starter ground participants and explicit Han Solo 1_11 identity only. Han metadata does not admit deployment, redraw, pilot or other full-card behavior. Other Han personas/permanent pilots, targetability/inactivity/capture, general zone-change target identity, cancellation/prevention/replacement and arbitrary continuous modifier order remain unfinished. Native cancellation, Han movement, concession and Doomed state-intervention branches are component fixtures, not fresh executed cancellation/movement cards. Full native card/deck admission and service/UI stay gated.
